name: agent-guide
body: Agent guide: the embedded author-guide content and the verbatim write of the full guide for all three scaffolding forms — the deck-root full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md`, written by `kalide init` and `kalide init <path>` (agent-authoring, agent-guide-reference), and the library-root full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md`, written by `kalide init-library` (library-agent-guide, library-guide-layout). Each full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` is written verbatim only when absent. Each `AGENTS.md` pointer is written per agent-guide-reference: created carrying the embedded pointer content (agent-guide-reference), left untouched when it carries the string, otherwise appended to. The pointer's permitted modifications are exactly agent-guide-reference's set, and the known-full-guide replacement belongs to `kalide upgrade` (solution.component.upgrade). Realised by the scaffold package's embedded guide files and writers (internal/scaffold) — Init, writeHelloSeed, InitExternal and InitLibrary — and announced by the CLI handlers (internal/cli). The build/test-time drift self-test (agent-guide-drift-check) guards both full guides and the pointer content.
